title: Deeper/broader OpenCADStudio v2026.42 SAT import and repository identity screen
mode: primary-source web research and plan-only update
scope: Refresh the current OpenCADStudio release route for standalone SAT/ACIS model import
Separate direct SAT import from DXF-inline ACIS and DWG AcDs carrier routes
Screen a same-name repository for release, source ancestry, and artifact identity before counting it as peer evidence
Refine optional composed-checkpoint readiness without increasing ordinary validation frequency

method.kind: Read project-owned GitHub repository and release pages; compare product identity, release metadata, and README route references
method.limitations: The v2026.42 release notes advertise SAT/ACIS import, but its tagged Cargo manifest/lock, exact parser route, profile support, loss behavior, and release artifact hash were not resolved or executed in this screen. The same-name repository's source ancestry and maintainer relationship were not established; no allegation about its origin is implied.

sources.revision: v2026.42 release page, app commit b6fbac3; published 2026-10-18
sources.observed: The release notes advertise new IMPORT/ACISIN workflows and SAT/ACIS model import. This establishes a newly documented standalone-SAT application route, but not its exact SAT grammar/profile, full-body semantic behavior, fallback contract, dependency resolution, or successful execution.

The repository uses the same product name and overlapping feature prose, has no listed releases, is not presented by GitHub as a fork, and its README points to HakanSeven12's web app and download/release routes. Source ancestry, binary provenance, and a maintainer relationship were not established. It is excluded from independent peer counts pending provenance review.

assessment.planImpact: Adds an optional standalone SAT-to-application/kernel route for a future composed checkpoint, explicitly separate from DXF-inline ACIS and DWG AcDs extraction. Adds a repository-identity admission guard for same-name project pages. The route remains unqualified until exact source/dependency/artifact provenance and independent semantic results are available.

implementationReadyChecks: Do not add OpenCADStudio as a routine dependency, CMake target, CI job, fixture, or per-slice validation prerequisite.
Before any optional v2026.42 run, bind tag/commit, exact platform artifact and SHA-256, tagged Cargo manifest/lock, toolchain, feature flags, and resolved opencadcodec/opencadkernel revisions.
Source-audit the standalone IMPORT/ACISIN path and record the actual accepted SAT profile before interpreting an execution result.

Use only locally authored scratch SAT controls with independently authored topology, units, transforms, bounds, area, and volume expectations; record all unsupported/lost bodies and fallback/refusal outcomes.
Do not transfer standalone SAT results to DXF-inline SAT/SAB, DWG AcDs ownership, entity-to-payload association, or FreeCAD native qualification.
Admit same-name repositories only after canonical owner/repository, immutable revision, source ancestry, dependencies, and executable provenance are established.
Keep findings 133/76 and J256/J260/J268/J284/J293/J295 DEFERRED_EXTERNAL; no support claim changes from release notes or repository identity alone.
